The bib features a complex, chaotic collage of printed patterns including grids, stripes, and abstract shapes. It has a standard bib silhouette with a neck hole and a curved bottom edge. There are visible signs of physical deformation or melting at the top right corner.

The edge of the neck hole is irregular and seems to fuse with the background or the melted plastic above it, lacking a clean, manufactured edge.
